summary: trivago N.V. filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 financial results and a share buyback program. The supervisory board authorized up to $20 million in share repurchases, with execution planned to start at the end of May. The company reported total revenue growth of 15%, an improved net loss, and raised 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance to around €25 million. The buyback reflects confidence in long-term value creation, supported by a cash position of €136.1 million and zero long-term debt. Watch for execution details and impact on share price.
